title: Candlestick Pattern Recognition
text: candlestick shows four prices chosen time period: Open, High, Low, Close (OHLC). real body segment Open Close. Close Open candle bullish; otherwise bearish. upper shadow extends top real body High; lower shadow extends bottom real body Low. Together shadows show far price moved beyond Open-Close range. Candlestick patterns defined comparing size position bodies shadows—within single candle across sequence consecutive candles.

title: Candlestick Pattern Recognition
text: Pattern recognition {talib} relies classifying candle’s body shadows “long”, “short”, “doji-like”, etc. classifications controlled two parameters per setting: N (lookback): many prior candles average computing reference value. alpha (sensitivity): multiplier applied reference value. current candle tested alpha * reference. settings modified via options() take effect next pattern function call.

title: Candlestick Pattern Recognition
text: Changing N alters many prior candles form reference average. shorter lookback makes reference reactive recent price action:
code: ## default N = 10 sum(abs(talib::doji(talib::BTC)), na.rm = TRUE) #> [1] 56 ## shorter lookback options(talib.BodyDoji.N = 3) sum(abs(talib::doji(talib::BTC)), na.rm = TRUE) #> [1] 61

title: Candlestick Pattern Recognition
text: Changing alpha makes classification less permissive. higher alpha means wider acceptance threshold: default alpha = 0.1 BodyDoji means: “real body doji-like ’s shorter 10% average high-low range past 10 candles.” Doubling 0.2 loosens criterion identifies patterns.
code: ## default alpha = 0.1 sum(abs(talib::doji(talib::BTC)), na.rm = TRUE) #> [1] 56 ## more permissive: accept bodies up to 20% of the high-low range options(talib.BodyDoji.alpha = 0.2) sum(abs(talib::doji(talib::BTC)), na.rm = TRUE) #> [1] 109

title: Candlestick Pattern Recognition
text: Different patterns depend different settings. general rule: Doji patterns (doji(), doji_star(), dragonfly_doji(), gravestone_doji(), long_legged_doji(), rickshaw_man()) primarily controlled BodyDoji. Engulfing-style patterns (engulfing(), harami(), dark_cloud_cover(), piercing()) depend BodyLong BodyShort. Star patterns (morning_star(), evening_star(), abandoned_baby()) depend BodyShort, BodyLong, shadow settings. Hammer/Shooting Star (hammer(), shooting_star(), inverted_hammer(), hanging_man()) primarily depend ShadowLong BodyShort. Distance-based comparisons (kicking(), matching_low(), counter_attack()) use Near, Far, Equal settings.

title: Financial Charts
text: Use indicator() attach technical indicators recent chart(). Indicators overlay price (e.g., Bollinger Bands, moving averages) drawn main panel. Indicators scale (e.g., RSI, MACD) drawn sub-panels . Multiple sub-panel indicators stack vertically. main chart occupies 70% height default (controlled talib.chart.main).

text: Real-world data often contains missing values. default (na.bridge = FALSE), NA input propagates entire calculation, can fill result NAs. title: {talib}: Technical Analysis for R
text: {talib} R package technical analysis, candlestick pattern recognition, interactive financial charting—built TA-Lib C library. provides 67 technical indicators, 61 candlestick patterns, composable charting system powered {plotly} {ggplot2}. indicator computations implemented C via .Call() minimal overhead. Alongside {TTR}, {talib} adds candlestick pattern recognition interactive charts R technical analysis ecosystem.
code: {     ## create a candlestick chart     talib::chart(BTC, title = "Bitcoin (BTC)")      ## overlay Bollinger Bands on     ## the price panel     talib::indicator(talib::bollinger_bands)      ## mark Engulfing candlestick     ## patterns on the chart     talib::indicator(talib::engulfing, data = BTC)      ## add RSI and volume as     ## separate sub-panels     talib::indicator(talib::RSI)     talib::indicator(talib::trading_volume) }

title: {talib}: Technical Analysis for R
text: Charts built two steps: chart() creates price chart, indicator() layers technical indicators. Overlap indicators (moving averages, Bollinger Bands) draw price panel; oscillators (RSI, MACD) get sub-panels.  Multiple indicators can share sub-panel passing calls:  charting system ships 5 built-themes: default, hawks_and_doves, payout, tp_slapped, trust_the_process. Switch themes set_theme(). {plotly} (interactive, default) {ggplot2} (static) backends supported:
code: {     ## price chart with two moving     ## averages and MACD below     talib::chart(BTC)     talib::indicator(talib::SMA, n = 7)     talib::indicator(talib::SMA, n = 14)     talib::indicator(talib::MACD) } {     talib::chart(BTC)     talib::indicator(talib::BBANDS)      ## pass multiple calls to combine     ## them on a single sub-panel     talib::indicator(         talib::RSI(n = 10),         talib::RSI(n = 14),         talib::RSI(n = 21)     ) } {     ## switch to ggplot2 backend with     ## the "Hawks and Doves" theme     talib::set_theme("hawks_and_doves")     talib::chart(BTC, title = "Bitcoin (BTC)")     talib::indicator(talib::BBANDS)     talib::indicator(talib::RSI)     talib::indicator(talib::trading_volume) }

title: Abandoned Baby — abandoned_baby
text: Every indicator always emits leading NAs initial lookback period - positions yet enough data produce result. separate NAs already present input handled, controlled na.bridge argument: na.bridge = FALSE (default) input passed underlying TA-Lib C routine -. indicators smooth across time (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ...), single NA input typically propagates forward poisons every subsequent value - common one missing observation produce output entirely NA position onward. mode right choice want see missing data output rather silently compute around . na.bridge = TRUE NA rows stripped input C routine runs; indicator computed resulting dense series; results re-expanded original length NA inserted every position input NA. Output length always matches input length, result can joined back source data.frame row. Consequence understand enabling: bridging causes indicator treat non-consecutive observations consecutive. 14-period RSI na.bridge = TRUE series containing month-long gap compute using 14 observations span several real-world months 14 adjacent trading days. sparse missing values (e.g. single missing tick) harmless; clustered gaps (e.g. delisted period, weekend encoded NA) output correctly aligned position economically meaningless across gap. Inspect gap structure (.na(x)) enabling low-quality time series.

title: Abandoned Baby — abandoned_baby
text: x OHLC-V series coercible data.frame. cols (formula). optional 4-variable formula selecting columns x via model.frame. Defaults ~open + high + low + close. eps (double). Penetration threshold candlestick pattern recognition, expressed fraction candle body. double length 1. na.bridge (logical). logical length 1. FALSE default. FALSE, input NAs propagate TA-Lib C routine (indicators fill remaining output NA). TRUE, input NA rows stripped computation re-inserted original positions output, causing indicator treat non-consecutive non-NA observations adjacent — see Handling NA values section consequences. ... Additional parameters passed model.frame.

title: Abandoned Baby — abandoned_baby
text: object class length x: CDLABANDONEDBABY integer Pattern codes depend options(talib.normalize): TRUE: 1 = identified pattern; -1 = identified bearish pattern. FALSE: 100 = identified pattern; -100 = identified bearish pattern. 0 = pattern.

title: Abandoned Baby — abandoned_baby
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

title: Belt Hold — belt_hold
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: chart() creates interactive candlestick OHLC bar charts financial price data. initializes charting environment subsequent calls indicator() can attach technical indicators subcharts. Calling chart() without arguments resets charting environment, clearing stored chart state (main chart, subcharts, data). See vignette(topic = "charting", package = "talib") comprehensive guide building multi-panel technical analysis charts.

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: x OHLC-V data.frame (object coercible one) columns named open, high, low, close, optionally volume. Column names case-sensitive. type character string, either "candlestick" (default) "ohlc". Candlestick charts use filled/hollow bodies wicks; OHLC charts use vertical bars horizontal open/close ticks. idx optional vector length number rows x. Replaces default x-axis labels (row names integer index). Useful custom date formatting non-standard index types. title optional character string chart title. omitted, title inferred variable name passed x. ... Additional parameters passed backend chart constructor (e.g., plotly::plot_ly()).

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: chart object whose class depends active backend: "plotly" backend: plotly object (interactive HTML widget). "ggplot2" backend: gg object (static plot). called without arguments, returns NULL invisibly.

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: chart() acts entry point package's charting system. stores OHLC data main price chart internally subsequent indicator() calls can attach panels price chart without requiring data passed . chart title automatically inferred name object passed x (e.g., chart(BTC) produces title "BTC"). title also displays number observations , available, date range. Two rendering backends supported: "plotly" (default) Produces interactive HTML charts hover tooltips, pan/zoom, built-drawing tools (lines, rectangles). Requires plotly package. "ggplot2" Produces static charts suitable reports publications. Requires ggplot2 package.

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: following options() control chart appearance behavior: talib.chart.backend [character] "plotly" default. Set "ggplot2" static charts. talib.chart.slider [logical] FALSE default. TRUE, range slider added x-axis interactive zooming (plotly backend ). talib.chart.slider.size [numeric] 0.05 default. Controls height range slider fraction total chart height. talib.chart.legend [logical] TRUE default. FALSE, legends hidden panels. talib.chart.scale [numeric] 1 default. scaling factor applied font sizes. Values greater 1 increase font size. talib.chart.main [numeric] 0.7 default. fraction total chart height allocated main price panel subcharts present. Colors controlled via set_theme(). See set_theme() available themes color customization.

title: Create an OHLC Chart — chart
text: chart() + indicator() pair follows active-target model base R's plot() / lines(). chart() called stashes per-pipeline state object caller's evaluation frame; subsequent indicator() calls retrieve state walking call stack. practical consequences: chart() subsequent indicator() calls must live enclosing frame - REPL session, function body, renderPlot() / renderPlotly() block, local({...}) expression, testthat::test_that({...}) block, etc. Splitting across unrelated helpers supported. Two unrelated function bodies (two parallel renderPlot() callbacks Shiny app, two future::future() blocks) get frame, chart states isolated construction - without talib taking dependency Shiny, promises, futures. Calling chart() arguments clears state caller's frame, mirroring fresh plot() call new device.

title: Chart Themes — chart_themes
text: charting system ships set built-color themes. theme controls candle colors, background, text, grid lines, 10-color palette (colorway) used distinguish indicator lines. Use set_theme() apply list themes.

title: Chart Themes — chart_themes
text: default dark theme cyan steel-blue tones. Light (#E0FFFF) bullish candles near-black (#141414) background cool blue (#4682B4) bearish candle. colorway spans icy blues teal soft purple. hawks_and_doves light, grayscale theme white background. title: Closing Marubozu — closing_marubozu
text: closing_marubozu() generic S3 function preserves input class: data.frame , data.frame ; matrix , matrix .

title: Closing Marubozu — closing_marubozu
text: Every indicator always emits leading NAs initial lookback period - positions yet enough data produce result. separate NAs already present input handled, controlled na.bridge argument: na.bridge = FALSE (default) input passed underlying TA-Lib C routine -. indicators smooth across time (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ...), single NA input typically propagates forward poisons every subsequent value - common one missing observation produce output entirely NA position onward. mode right choice want see missing data output rather silently compute around . na.bridge = TRUE NA rows stripped input C routine runs; indicator computed resulting dense series; results re-expanded original length NA inserted every position input NA. Output length always matches input length, result can joined back source data.frame row. Consequence understand enabling: bridging causes indicator treat non-consecutive observations consecutive. 14-period RSI na.bridge = TRUE series containing month-long gap compute using 14 observations span several real-world months 14 adjacent trading days. sparse missing values (e.g. single missing tick) harmless; clustered gaps (e.g. delisted period, weekend encoded NA) output correctly aligned position economically meaningless across gap. Inspect gap structure (.na(x)) enabling low-quality time series.

text: x OHLC-V series coercible data.frame. cols (formula). optional 4-variable formula selecting columns x via model.frame. text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

title: Fast Stochastic — fast_stochastic
text: Every indicator always emits leading NAs initial lookback period - positions yet enough data produce result. separate NAs already present input handled, controlled na.bridge argument: na.bridge = FALSE (default) input passed underlying TA-Lib C routine -. indicators smooth across time (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ...), single NA input typically propagates forward poisons every subsequent value - common one missing observation produce output entirely NA position onward. mode right choice want see missing data output rather silently compute around . na.bridge = TRUE NA rows stripped input C routine runs; indicator computed resulting dense series; results re-expanded original length NA inserted every position input NA. Output length always matches input length, result can joined back source data.frame row. Consequence understand enabling: bridging causes indicator treat non-consecutive observations consecutive. 14-period RSI na.bridge = TRUE series containing month-long gap compute using 14 observations span several real-world months 14 adjacent trading days. sparse missing values (e.g. single missing tick) harmless; clustered gaps (e.g. delisted period, weekend encoded NA) output correctly aligned position economically meaningless across gap. Inspect gap structure (.na(x)) enabling low-quality time series.

text: Every indicator always emits leading NAs initial lookback period - positions yet enough data produce result. separate NAs already present input handled, controlled na.bridge argument: na.bridge = FALSE (default) input passed underlying TA-Lib C routine -. indicators smooth across time (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ...), single NA input typically propagates forward poisons every subsequent value - common one missing observation produce output entirely NA position onward. mode right choice want see missing data output rather silently compute around . na.bridge = TRUE NA rows stripped input C routine runs; indicator computed resulting dense series; results re-expanded original length NA inserted every position input NA. Output length always matches input length, result can joined back source data.frame row. Consequence understand enabling: bridging causes indicator treat non-consecutive observations consecutive. 14-period RSI na.bridge = TRUE series containing month-long gap compute using 14 observations span several real-world months 14 adjacent trading days. sparse missing values (e.g. single missing tick) harmless; clustered gaps (e.g. delisted period, weekend encoded NA) output correctly aligned position economically meaningless across gap. Inspect gap structure (.na(x)) enabling low-quality time series.

title: Hikkake — hikakke
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

title: Morning Doji Star — morning_doji_star
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

Output length matches input length, computation treats non-consecutive observations adjacent - fine sparse missing values, misleading across clustered gaps.

title: Separating Lines — separating_lines
text: separating_lines() generic S3 function preserves input class: data.frame , data.frame ; matrix , matrix .

title: Separating Lines — separating_lines
text: Every indicator always emits leading NAs initial lookback period - positions yet enough data produce result. separate NAs already present input handled, controlled na.bridge argument: na.bridge = FALSE (default) input passed underlying TA-Lib C routine -. indicators smooth across time (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ...), single NA input typically propagates forward poisons every subsequent value - common one missing observation produce output entirely NA position onward. mode right choice want see missing data output rather silently compute around . na.bridge = TRUE NA rows stripped input C routine runs; indicator computed resulting dense series; results re-expanded original length NA inserted every position input NA. Output length always matches input length, result can joined back source data.frame row. Consequence understand enabling: bridging causes indicator treat non-consecutive observations consecutive. 14-period RSI na.bridge = TRUE series containing month-long gap compute using 14 observations span several real-world months 14 adjacent trading days. sparse missing values (e.g. single missing tick) harmless; clustered gaps (e.g. delisted period, weekend encoded NA) output correctly aligned position economically meaningless across gap. Inspect gap structure (.na(x)) enabling low-quality time series.

title: Separating Lines — separating_lines
text: x OHLC-V series coercible data.frame. cols (formula). optional 4-variable formula selecting columns x via model.frame. Defaults ~open + high + low + close. na.bridge (logical). logical length 1. FALSE default. FALSE, input NAs propagate TA-Lib C routine (indicators fill remaining output NA). TRUE, input NA rows stripped computation re-inserted original positions output, causing indicator treat non-consecutive non-NA observations adjacent — see Handling NA values section consequences. ... Additional parameters passed model.frame.

title: Separating Lines — separating_lines
text: object class length x: CDLSEPARATINGLINES integer Pattern codes depend options(talib.normalize): TRUE: 1 = identified pattern; -1 = identified bearish pattern. FALSE: 100 = identified pattern; -100 = identified bearish pattern. 0 = pattern.

title: Separating Lines — separating_lines
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.

text: Serkan Korkmaz

title: Set or List Chart Themes — set_theme
text: set_theme supports three usage patterns: set_theme() Returns character vector available theme names. set_theme("payout") Applies named theme. set_theme$payout Applies named theme via $ syntax (supports tab-completion interactive sessions). Themes can combined individual color overrides. name ... provided, base theme applied first, overrides applied top:   also possible override individual properties without selecting theme:   See chart_themes full description available themes color properties.

title: Set or List Chart Themes — set_theme
code: ## list available themes talib::set_theme() #> [1] "default"            "hawks_and_doves"    "payout"             #> [4] "tp_slapped"         "trust_the_process"  "bloomberg_terminal" #> [7] "limit_up"           "bid_n_ask"           ## apply a theme by name talib::set_theme("payout")  ## apply a theme with custom overrides talib::set_theme(   "hawks_and_doves",   background_color = "#FAFAFA" )  ## override individual properties ## without switching theme talib::set_theme(   bearish_body = "#FF4444",   bullish_body = "#44FF44" )  ## reset to default theme talib::set_theme("default")

title: Upside/Downside Gap Three Methods — xside_gap_3_methods
text: General options candlestick pattern recognition: N integer. Controls number candles consider identifying patterns. alpha double. sensitivity parameter identifying patterns. Available options defaults: BodyLong (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body long longer average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyVeryLong (N = 10, alpha = 3.0). Real body long longer 3 times average 10 previous candles' real body. BodyShort (N = 10, alpha = 1.0). Real body short shorter average 10 previous candles' real bodies. BodyDoji (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Real body like doji's body shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. ShadowLong (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow long longer real body. ShadowVeryLong (N = 0, alpha = 2.0). Shadow long longer 2 times real body. ShadowShort (N = 0, alpha = 1.0). Shadow short shorter half average 10 previous candles' sum shadows. ShadowVeryShort (N = 10, alpha = 0.1). Shadow short shorter 10% average 10 previous candles' high-low range. Near (N = 5, alpha = 0.2). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "near" means "<=20% average 5 previous candles high low range." Far (N = 5, alpha = 0.6). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "far" means ">= 60% average 5 previous candles high-low range." Equal (N = 5, alpha = 0.05). measuring distance parts candles width gaps "equal" means "<= 5% average 5 previous candles high-low range." options can modified running options(talib.BodyLong.N = 5, talib.BodyLong.alpha = 0.2). See vignette("candlestick") details.
